storage.value:
As a system user 

I want to view all groups of penalties listing 

So that I will be able to get information about groups of penalties and perform operations 

Acceptance Criteria 

  1. Check system user permissions to view groups of penalties listing 

    1. Viewing groups of penalties 

      1. Allows to see all groups of penalties in system 

    2. Viewing deleted groups of penalties 

      1. Allows to see deleted groups of penalties 

  2. To be able to see the default state of the page:

    1. page title 'Group of Penalties'

    2. Search

      1. Search box

      2. Search dropdown, with selected default meaning 'All'

      3. Search icon, gray by default

    3. Exclude Old Version

      1. Checkbox

      2. Optional

      3. In the Group of Penalties listing we need to add a checkbox - “Exclude old versions”, this checkbox should be added after the field and the buttons for Search. These checkboxes are optional and enabled always

      4. In the system, if the user writes a value in the search + filter as well, the system will show all the results in which at least one of the versions has such a value. These checkboxes will help us to easily find our value in the current and future version

    4. Exclude Future version

      1. Checkbox

      2. Optional

      3. In the Group of Penalties listing we need to add a checkbox - “Exclude future versions”, this checkbox should be added after the Exclude old version checkbox. These checkboxes are optional and enabled always

      4. In the system, if the user writes a value in the search + filter as well, the system will show all the results in which at least one of the versions has such a value. These checkboxes will help us to easily find our value in the current and past version

    5. When these checkboxes are selected simultaneously, they should exclude old and future (for time-based) versions from the results and search only for the current version.

  3. Should load list of all groups of penalties in system 

    1. By default should load latest Groups of penalties (the latest created group should load first in a list) 

    2. Only current version of groups of penalties is displayed in a list 

    3. By default it should display 25 records in one page with the possibility to change the number of displayed items in a page. Hardcoded values for dropdown: 25, 50, 100 

  4. Total count of groups of penalties should be loaded  

  5. Pagination  

    • To be able to navigate through next /previous page 

    • To be able to navigate to first/last page 

    • To be able use arrow back/forward for navigation  

    • To be able to go to a certain page from dropdown with available pages 

    • To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter will directly load that page 

  6. In each row in a groups of penalties list should load: 

    1. ID 

      1. unique identifier of groups of penalties. System generates after creation 

    2. Name 

    3. Number of penalties 

    4. Date of creation 

    5. Actions: 

      1. Edit Group 

      2. Delete Group 

  7. To display loader while loading the list 

  8. Search groups of penalties list 

    1. To be able to search group of penalties by predefined values: 

      1. Group of penalties name 

      2. penalties name 

    2. Min 1 character is required to enable search icon 

      1. Empty search box state with gray search/clear search icon 

    3. To be able to click on a search icon to run search when min 1 character is typed 

    4. Search should run in all versions of groups of penalties but will return and display current group of penalties version  

    5. To display loader while loading search results 

    6. To be able to select in which values to search for groups of penalties 

      1. All (By default) 

      2. Groups of penalties name 

      3. Penalty name 

  9. Up/down arrows next to column title for sorting full list 

    1. ASC/DESC order 

    2. All columns should be sortable 

  10. Create New Groups of penalties 

    1. Clicking on it will open Groups of penalties creation page 

  11. View Groups of penalties 

    1. Clicking on a row will open Groups of penalties detail page, read only mode 

  12. Edit Groups of penalties 

    1. Edit icon will be always visible and active 

    2. Clicking on edit icon will open Groups of penalties detail page in editing mode 

      1. Edit operation is not always allowed on a Groups of penalties – editing operation is enabled only if group of penalties is not connected to product/service with created contract or when user has permission to edit locked objects  

  13. Delete Groups of penalties 

    1. For deleting Groups of penalties user should have permission ‘Deleting Groups of penalties’ 

      1. If no, disable delete icon 

      2. If yes, enable delete icon 

    2. By clicking on delete icon system should display warning message:  

      1. ‘Are you sure you want to delete the Groups of penalties?’ 

        1. YES – deletes Group of penalties 

          1. check if Groups of penalties can be deleted – if the Group is empty and is not connected to product/service   

        2. Cancel – popup is closed and is not deleted 

    3. Audit Log record should be created 

 

  • Page orders in left Menu:

    1. Products

    2. Services

    3. Goods

    4. Price component

    5. Group of price components

    6. Terms

    7. Group of terms

    8. Interim & advance payment

    9. Group of Interim & advance payment

    10. Termination

    11. Group of terminations

    12. Penalty

    13. Group of penalties

    14. Price Parameter

Audit Log  

  • Audit Log record should be created on adding/Editing/Removing actions   

    • No need to create Audit Log record on Move to top/Drag & Drop 

Dark mode

  • By default system’s color is light mode

    • it is possible to switch system’s color to Dark mode by clicking on 'Dark Mode' icon in header; Clicking again will switch to light mode

    • Tab navigation

      • To be able to have keyboard navigation via tab, shift tab, Enter/space keys (left-right)

      • Disabled fields should be skipped
